communes: Gimenells I El Pla De La Font

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Catalan DO in Lleida province, split into sub-zones including Artesa, Valls de Riucorb, Garrigues, Raïmat, Pallars Jussà and Segrià. The allowed grape list is long and varied, from Tempranillo, Garnacha Tinta and Cabernet Sauvignon to Chardonnay, Macabeo and Riesling.
